_comment: Curated bundles. Editorial: the title, blurb, audience and difficulty are our own words; every item is a catalog listing id. `scripts/check-bundles.mjs` (part of `npm run lint`) fails when an id is missing from the catalog or `litespm install` cannot complete it, so nothing here can quietly go stale. `litespm install` takes exactly one id per command, so a bundle installs as one command per line.

bundles.title: Full-stack web dev
bundles.blurb: Manage the repo, drive a real browser to test what you build, look up current library docs, and deploy, all from the agent.

bundles.title: Office documents
bundles.blurb: Anthropic's official document skills: read and produce PDFs, Word documents, spreadsheets and slide decks.

bundles.title: Databases
bundles.blurb: Hosted Postgres from Supabase and Neon, plus vendor skills for Neon Postgres and MongoDB schema and query work.
bundles.audience: Developers building on Postgres or MongoDB

bundles.title: Docs-grounded coding
bundles.blurb: Stop the agent guessing at APIs: current library documentation from Context7, plus web search from Brave.

bundles.title: Browser testing and QA
bundles.blurb: Playwright MCP to drive a browser, and Playwright skills that explore a site and generate tests.
bundles.audience: Developers and QA writing end-to-end tests

bundles.title: Errors and observability
bundles.blurb: Pull real production errors from Sentry and metrics from Grafana, then let the agent trace and fix them.
bundles.audience: Developers on call for a running service

bundles.title: Design to code
bundles.blurb: Read Figma files from the agent and turn them into components, with Playwright to check the result in a browser.

bundles.title: Project tracking
bundles.blurb: Work with the trackers and wikis a team already uses: Linear issues, Notion pages and Atlassian (Jira and Confluence).
bundles.audience: Teams managing work in Linear, Notion or Jira

bundles.title: Payments with Stripe
bundles.blurb: Stripe's own MCP server plus its best-practices and documentation skills for building a checkout.

bundles.title: Cloud and infrastructure
bundles.blurb: Cloudflare's MCP server, Docker build and Compose guidance, and HashiCorp's Terraform policy skill.
bundles.audience: Engineers who run their own infrastructure

bundles.title: Build your own MCP server
bundles.blurb: Anthropic's skill for designing an MCP server, the Claude API reference, current docs from Context7, and GitHub to publish it.
bundles.audience: Developers writing MCP servers or Claude integrations
